title: Independent manually derived NLHE settlement vectors — bounded P1 slice
status: Frozen review inputs and expectations; not execution results
scope: Single-table p2-house-1 integer play chips. No external engine, production reducer, legalActions output or project output was used to calculate expected amounts. API/representation was inspected only for adapter compatibility.
independenceLimit: Winners are explicitly stipulated independent ranking inputs, not evaluator results. These vectors test accounting and specified betting boundaries; they do not qualify card evaluation or full independent differential settlement coverage.

commonSetup.seatOrderMeaning: seatOrder is clockwise; first eligible tied winner strictly left of dealer receives first odd chip
commonSetup.setup: CreateSession with startingStacks in seatOrder; StartHand with all listed activeSeatIds, dealerSeatId and a fresh handId. Execute commands in their literal order. Do not choose commands/expected winners from engine output.
commonSetup.assertions: Assert exact contributions, folded seats, stack before proposal, pots/eligibility, proposal awards, unchanged stack on proposal, final stacks only after ConfirmSettlement; total stacks plus committed contributions conserved at each accepted step. Repeated confirm without a new proposal rejects.
commonSetup.expectedPotRepresentation: Adjacent contribution layers with identical eligibility can be combined. expectedPots below use the current public contract's combined representation. Single-contributor excess is identified separately as uncalledReturn, even if represented as a single-eligible settlement entry.
commonSetup.winnerOrder: winnersByPot may intentionally use reverse tied-seat order to verify house-rule ordering rather than caller order.

vectors.purpose: Three nested pools, distinct winners and folded-free eligibility caps
derivation: 0..30: four contributors => 30*4=120; A wins stipulated strongest eligible hand.
30..60: B,C,D => 30*3=90; B wins stipulated next strongest hand.
Stipulated strict ranking A>B>C>D is consistent across all pots; a short stack cannot win a pool above its contribution.

negativeChecks.description: A cannot win first side pot

vectors.purpose: Folded contributors remain in amounts and never in eligibility
derivation: A pays10 preflop+20 flop then folds; D pays10 preflop then folds. B,C each pay10+20+30=60.
Layers:10*4=40; (30-10)*3=60; (60-30)*2=60. Only B,C remain eligible in every layer, hence combined160.
C stipulated stronger than B gets160; folded A,D keep only their uncommitted70,90. Final70+40+200+90=400.

negativeChecks.description: Folded A is ineligible despite contributing30

vectors.purpose: An overbet above the opponent's entire stack returns to its contributor; it is not a contested side pot
derivation: Matched stakes are40 from each player => contested80. A's remaining100-40=60 has no opponent and belongs back to A irrespective of hand rank.
Stipulate B beats A. B receives80; A receives its own60. Sum140.

Current explicit-confirmation representation may keep60 as a single-eligible entry until settlement; do not call it a contested side pot or require a new pre-confirmation refund event in this bounded slice. Economic outcome is fixed.

negativeChecks.description: B cannot be awarded A's uncalled60

vectors.purpose: Odd chip follows clockwise order left of dealer; dead money produces an odd total
derivation: Preflop all pay5; turn A,B pay4 each while C folds =>15+8=23. A and B stipulated tie.
23=11*2+1. Clockwise left of button C is A, so A gets12 and B11 even when input lists B first.
Final91+12=103;91+11=102;C95. Sum300. No folded seat receives an odd chip.

vectors.purpose: Two individually short increases cumulatively reopen a prior actor; then exact side-pot settlement

checkpoints.derivation: A raised2 to10: last full raise increment8. Unacted B all-in13 adds3; unacted C all-in20 adds7. Each is below8, but A now faces20-10=10>=8. Minimum full raise is20+8=28. D's call does not change increment.

derivation: 13 from all four =>52. Further7 from A,C,D =>21. Total73.

Final80+52+0+101=233; B's lower contribution cannot win the side pool.
Flop/turn/river active order is D then A, after dealer B while C is all-in; both check each street.

checkpoints.derivation: A's full raise increment is8. B increases10 to13 by3<8. C,D only call. A faces3, so its raise rights remain closed despite C,D retaining chips.

consumptionGuidance: Use literal expected data, never update expected amounts to make a failing production result pass. Investigate disagreement and return a finding to PM/Architect.

Translate commands to existing AccountingCommand API without modifying production to accommodate fixture setup. Every command sequence should be accepted; verify afterCommandCount checkpoints before next command.
Do not use production validate/derivePots/evaluator as the sole oracle. validate may be an additional assertion.

Proposal must not pay out; confirmation must conserve sessionTotal and clear contributions. At authority integration separately test stable-command duplicate receipt and failed commit without projection/ack.
Prefer all six vectors if feasible. If time-limited, PM records precisely which IDs ran, with untouched remaining IDs as pending.
No external oracle is needed for these arithmetic and stipulated-ranking vectors. Full differential qualification and independent evaluator verification remain future work.
This artifact records manual mathematics and API compatibility observations only; no tests have been executed by its author.
